campaign.title: Unbalanced dual off-product actual-sign sector gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Import no estimate unless its primary statement controls the literal moving-profile square-root phase with the actual quarter character, exact Fejer triangle, zero extension, and X^(1/2) energy target. A coefficient-blind large sieve or a transform identity is not a saving.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete Round-124 dual off-product aggregate be bounded at the square target by a genuinely signed inequality, or can a violation be localized to a strictly smaller complete sector before this UNBAL lane is parked?
frozen_target.reference_formula: S_off=S_eq^(nonzero)+S_neq, with S_eq^(nonzero)=C_H sum_p sum_(0<|h|<H)(H-|h|)sum_k b_(p,k+h)conj(b_(p,k)) and S_neq=C_H sum_(p!=q)chi_4(p)chi_4(q)sum_(|h|<H)(H-|h|)sum_k b_(p,k+h)conj(b_(q,k)); prove S_off<<X^(1/2+epsilon).
quantities: X real at least 2; M integer asymptotic to X with every physical amplitude frozen at X
D=X^delta, L=X^ell, K=XL/D^2, H=ceil(X^(1/2)/D), K asymptotic to LH^2
b_(p,k)=e(-1/8)M^(1/4)k^(-3/4)p^(-3/4)A_(p,k)e(sqrt(Mpk)) for positive odd p, with the literal moving profiles and zero extension
C_H=(J+H-1)/H^2, exact triangular Fejer weight, all positive and negative shifts, block entries and exits
D_0=C_H H sum_(p,k)|b_(p,k)|^2 is already O(X^(1/2))
D_0+S_eq^(nonzero)=C_H sum_p sum_n |sum_(a<H)b_(p,n+a)|^2 is positive but may be a stronger norm than the target
S_neq retains chi_4(p)chi_4(q), both ordered conjugates, moving p/k and q/k profiles, and no outside sectorwise modulus
the full scalar S_off is target-equivalent modulo accepted packages to the physical Round-123 survivor
the equal-mode and unequal-mode pieces may cancel, so separate absolute estimates are only sufficient
product-defect, gradient, and joint stationary-return identities from Round 124 retained as barriers, not gains
flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner only; every hard, sharp, clipped, starred, arithmetic, nonflat, and transition owner excluded

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact b_(p,k), D_0, S_eq^(nonzero), S_neq, Fejer, zero-extension, conjugacy, and target-equivalence identities without rectangularizing the profiles.
Determine whether the equal-mode shifted sector or its stronger positive p-row block energy is target-safe; quantify every integer crossing, curvature cell, endpoint, and capacity loss.
Estimate the complete unequal-mode actual-character aggregate, or prove precisely why product-defect progression, mode-difference summation, or a proposed large sieve is overstrong.
Retain possible cancellation between the two sectors unless a separate bound is actually proved; distinguish a scalar estimate from p-row, shiftwise, aliaswise, and coefficient-blind norms.
Prove the full target, a strict complete-sector saving, a stronger fixed-power inverse theorem, or the smallest rigorous no-go and exact parked survivor.
Audit moving profiles, short L, short H, negative shifts, Fejer cusp and faces, zero-extension entries and exits, support transitions, and every multiplicity seam.
State exactly what follows for flat-smooth UNBAL, complete UNBAL, hard TOP, BAL, M9-M2, M1, M9, the quarter theorem, and all exponents.

tasks.target: Independently derive the exact dual off-product problem and prove its target, a strict complete-sector saving, a stronger inverse theorem, or the smallest rigorous sectorwise no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-106 through Round-125 nonblind artifacts
required_output: An exact derivation of both sectors and every normalization.
A target estimate, strict saving, inverse theorem, or smallest no-go.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Develop a genuinely noninvertible actual-symbol inequality for the equal-mode shifted and unequal-mode sectors, preserving their possible cancellation and exhibiting the full factor beyond the Q capacity deficit.
required_output: Exact p-row and p-not-equal-q identities with a capacity ledger.
A proved inequality, strict sector, inverse theorem, or first invalid seam.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit sector splitting, positive p-row norms, crossing counts, character cancellation, moving profiles, endpoint ledgers, and every claimed factor in the Round-125 off-product proposal.
required_output: A pass/fail seam table for exact identities, capacities, and endpoint scope.
The maximal safe theorem or exact fatal correction.
A precise state recommendation and parked survivor if the route fails.

review_seams.requirement: The proof uses the exact Round-124 b_(p,k) and complete dual off-product aggregate, not a rectangular square-root model.
The off-zero equal-mode scalar is distinguished from the stronger positive p-row block energy, with all crossings and endpoints priced.
The actual chi_4(p)chi_4(q), product and gradient defects, mode multiplicities, and moving profiles survive until the claimed inequality.
Possible cancellation between equal-mode shifted and unequal-mode sectors is not discarded unless separate target bounds are proved.
Every norm states its capacity before use and exhibits the required factor beyond Q; unsigned capacity is not called a lower bound.
No flat-smooth strict-UNBAL result is promoted to complete UNBAL, hard TOP, BAL, M9-M2, M9, the quarter theorem, or an exponent without all graph bridges.
